'''2006 World Championship 6 V-Card Tournament Evan Fitzgerald LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Evan Fitzgerald]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (6 V-Card Tournament); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2006-11-08).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35797 Evan Fitzgerald's 6 V-Card Deck - WYS KDH (V)]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225941/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35797 Internet Archive]</ref>
